landing.intro: Programming is about more than writing code - it also means knowing how to interact effectively with your computer. Yet programming education often overlooks the importance of the development environment, leaving many learners frustrated. A development environment includes all the tools needed to write and run software, many of which are used through terminal commands. While most learners use Windows or macOS, much of the software world runs on Linux. Linux Odyssey is an interactive online learning platform designed to bridge that gap.
landing.feature1_desc: Setting up and using development tools can be a major hurdle for beginners. With Linux Odyssey, there is nothing to install - learners can access a real Linux environment directly from their browser.
landing.feature2_desc: Linux Odyssey combines the fun of gaming with practical learning. Through carefully designed levels, learners take on challenges, solve puzzles, and master Linux commands along the way.
landing.feature3_desc: Linux Odyssey goes beyond theory by providing real hands-on experience. Every command runs in a real Linux environment, giving learners an authentic introduction to the world of software development.
landing.start_journey: Grab your keyboard and begin your Linux adventure!
